  PROBLEM: test_intake_reports_when_another_run_was_not_examined uses a kind=issue payload, so run 501 is dropped at binding (run_not_in_source_repo) before the evidence loop and the test cannot reach its named scenario.
  WHY: Only run 500 enters the loop, so the runner_lost skip fires and the assertions on jobs_fetch_failed, the absence of skip reason=runner_lost, and the fingerprint line all fail. Severity is MAJOR in all sources, mapped to high.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1874-1889 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runner_lost skip gate (RUNNER_LOST_EXAMINED_RUNS) counts only runs that entered the evidence loop, not runs dropped at report binding.
  WHY: If one run is runner-lost and another is dropped at binding because its jobs read failed, the whole report is skipped as runner_lost and the real failure is suppressed, contrary to the fail-open-towards-filing contract. Confidence is 4 from gemini and z-ai and 5 from openai, so the merged value is 5.
